name: Moll FitzHamon

goals.text: be named Hamon undefined's child in front of the whole realm

memories: My mother told me on her deathbed whose child I am: Hamon undefined of House Sunspire.
The Bastard of Moonhold: A young woman called Moll FitzHamon rides into Moonhold with a ring of House Sunspire on a string round her neck, and asks for Hamon undefined.
